name: gfx_sync
doc: An NVN sync object, kept inside the guest's NVNsync (src/gfx/sync.ts; nxnative sync_t.fenced and fence). The pending states carry the fence number they wait for: PendingFence from nvnQueueFenceSync, PendingAcquire from nvnWindowAcquireTexture. Complete is nvnSyncWait finding the fence done (gfx_fence_done). A fenced sync is fenced again through Reset. Parked: nvnSyncWait with a non-zero timeout found the fence not done; the recorder never blocks, it returns TIMEOUT_EXPIRED and the embedder parks the thread (src/gfx/README.md, nvnSyncWait). The call made again after the park is Wake (the fence is done: CONDITION_SATISFIED) or, with timeout 0, Expire (TIMEOUT_EXPIRED).
